audit.whatIsWrong: Chart reads Skill/Shen/Shen/Skill/Skill/Shen/Shen; the packet chart is Skill/Maokai/Maokai/Maokai/Skill/Maokai/Skill and the audited mirror already set rows 1, 2, 3, 5 to Maokai and row 6 to Skill.
audit.why: Maokai's Twisted Advance root arrives at 2 and beats the Shadow Dash pattern outright; his Sap Magic sustain carries the extended trades through 4-5 and the first-item window. The existing whys[1] through whys[5] already describe Maokai winning those stages — only the side tokens disagreed.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 3, 5, 6 flipped as one atomic group in both layers, ratings dropped to 4/10 on the four Maokai rows.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] describes the level 2-3 spike with no cooldown and no mention of what actually makes Twisted Advance unbeatable in a burst trade.
audit.why: Twisted Advance is 14/13/12/11/10s and Maokai is UNTARGETABLE for the duration of the dash, so anything spent into it is spent into nothing.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text rebuilt on the 14s cooldown, the untargetable window, and the root that lands on arrival.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[0] attributes the root to Sapling Toss (E). Sapling Toss does not root — Twisted Advance (W) does. The untargetable frames on W and the Grievous Wounds requirement against Sap Magic are absent everywhere in the content layer. dontsFull[2] and report[11] call Nature's Grasp a knockback; it roots, and it is Bramble Smash (Q) that knocks back.
audit.why: Riot text: Twisted Advance — 'becoming untargetable and dashing to the target. Upon arrival, he roots the target.' Sapling Toss — flings a sapling to stand guard. Nature's Grasp — 'damaging and rooting any enemies in the path.' Sap Magic heals on attack and its cooldown drops each time he casts or is hit by a spell.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[0] now names Twisted Advance; spikes[0] carries the untargetable frames; whys[2] carries the anti-heal requirement; the R knockback wording is corrected to a root wall in dontsFull[2].t and report[11].t.

audit.why: Both suspectNames hits are false positives — 'Spirit's Refuge' and 'Stand United' are Shen's own real ability names. Maokai's Q carries a derived 'grounding' flag and his R a 'terrain' flag that Riot's descriptions do not support (a knockback-plus-slow shockwave, and an advancing bramble wall that roots); I asserted neither, so nothing on this page tells a player his dash can be grounded or walled off.

edits.before: Maokai's W root comes online — if he roots you before your E lands, he cancels the taunt and punishes your whole trade pattern.
edits.after: Twisted Advance is untargetable in flight on a 14s cooldown — burst spent into it is wasted, and the root on landing eats your taunt.

edits.before: Full kit on both sides, but Maokai's passive healing and W-root timing let him win extended trades that your short E-Q-shield pattern cannot match.
edits.after: Sap Magic heals off every spell he casts or eats, so Grievous Wounds decides long trades — keep yours short until you can buy that item.

edits.before: Root Shen with Sapling Toss before Shadow Dash so the taunt never connects
edits.after: Root Shen with Twisted Advance before Shadow Dash so the taunt never connects

edits.before: Get rooted into his combo. Fight in saplings. Eat his R knockback. Don't spend your ultimate on chip — it is the kill window.
edits.after: Get rooted into his combo. Fight in saplings. Eat his R root wall. Don't spend your ultimate on chip — it is the kill window.

notes: The packet lists a defect saying the chart contradicts the 52.86% win rate by giving Maokai 4/7 stages. I followed the packet chart and the already-audited mirror anyway: the whys already describe Maokai winning those exact stages, and Shen's win rate here comes from Stand United's map impact, not from winning the 1v1 — the Skill rows at level 6 and 2+ items are where that shows up. Flagging it rather than fighting the mirror. Also unfixed: mid says Twisted Advance is 'roughly 13 seconds at rank one' — it is 14s at rank 1, 13s at rank 2 — and late/mid still carry the sapling-block framing; both blocks are too long to rebuild inside +/-10% without dropping content.
